name: project-compilation-assembly-name-not-unique
body: CreateProjectCompilation names each compilation's assembly after the project's Name, so two projects with the same name produce two compilations with the same assembly name. This is harmless unless a third project references both, in which case Roslyn imports only one of them (CS1703) and that project resolves fewer references. Upgrade by making the assembly name unique (for example suffixing a path hash) when same-named projects referenced together appear.
